summary: First-run e2e testing of InnovaEnvios (Correios CWS integration). All 11 backend pytest tests passed and all 6 frontend user flows worked end-to-end via Playwright (dashboard, freight calc, tracking, prepost creation + label modal, list, contract settings).

issues: Radix warning: Missing `Description` or `aria-describedby={undefined}` for DialogContent (a11y). Add a DialogDescription or aria-describedby to silence and improve screen-reader support.

action_items: (minor) Add DialogDescription (or aria-describedby) to EtiquetaModal DialogContent to fix Radix a11y warning.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py line 268-274: `etapa_atual` computed twice; the intermediate `etapa_atual = min(n_eventos, len(etapas)) - 0` is dead code — remove.
server.py: no MongoDB _id leakage — good (uses projections / string _id singleton).
server.py stores full `codigo_acesso` in Mongo in plaintext (only masked on read). For production, consider hashing/encryption at rest — acceptable for MVP since documented.

server.py:462 uses `os.environ.get('CORS_ORIGINS','*').split(',')` combined with `allow_credentials=True`. Wildcard + credentials is invalid per CORS spec; will fail if browser needs credentials. Not exercised here (no auth) so no impact now.
server.py: `@app.on_event('shutdown')` is deprecated in FastAPI; use lifespan handlers.
Frontend Frete.jsx: no error UI when API fails beyond a toast — acceptable.
test_credentials: N/A — app has no auth; used in-app 'Usar dados de exemplo' on Contrato page.
seed_data_creation: Created 2 prepostagens via UI/tests (destinatarios: 'TEST_Destinatario', 'TEST Cliente Final'); one is cancelled by backend test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest suite is at /app/backend/tests/test_correios.py — reuse it. Frontend flows fully data-testid driven per /app/frontend/src/constants/testIds/correios.js. Demo mode is default; real Correios auth path (obter_token) was not exercised because homologation credentials are not confirmed.
